intent: Reduce what the browser has to do before the surface is usable.
moves: Animate only transform and opacity; everything else forces layout or paint.
Give images explicit dimensions so nothing shifts once they load.
Load below-the-fold images lazily and above-the-fold images eagerly.
Subset and preload the fonts actually used, and set a matching fallback metric.
Move long lists to virtualisation only after measuring that the list is the problem.
avoid: Animating width, height, top, or left.
Blocking first render on data that only the lower half of the page needs.
Optimising anything before measuring which part is actually slow.
